## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (typecheck, tests, build, export check)
- [ ] Tests cover the change, including the refusal path for anything near consent
- [ ] README (users), SPEC.md (message shapes) or plan/HARDENING.md (security) updated where it applies
- [ ] Examples changed? `pnpm templates` run and the regenerated `saydo.capabilities.json` committed
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
